question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**perspective**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank 5 is: **perspective**. 
 
• In this context, "**perspective**" refers to a particular way of regarding something or a viewpoint.
 
• **Primitive cultures,** despite their challenges, offer a different viewpoint or perspective on the world and its complexities. They bring unique insights and traditions that can enrich our understanding
